title: San Francisco-area estate sells for $70m in sign of AI-fueled wealth explosion
excerpt: New owner is said to be involved in AI industry, as new class of multimillionaires is entering the real estate race
content_html:
A luxury Lake Como-inspired estate in the San Francisco Bay Area has sold to a buyer “in the AI world” for a record $70m, in the latest sign of a new tech wealth boom that’s pushing home prices to extraordinary heights in the region

The property south of San Francisco not only becomes the most expensive sale in its affluent town of Hillsborough, doubling a previous record, but is also the most expensive sale in northern California this year, according to listing agent Jennifer Gilson of Golden Gate Sotheby’s International Realty.

Gilson declined to share any details about the buyer, other than that the new owner of 3000 Ralston Avenue is a man in the AI industry. It is the latest sign of a housing boom across Silicon Valley being driven by AI wealth. Last month, an analysis found that more than 140 San Francisco homes have sold at least $1m above their asking price in the first six months of this year.

The property, known as “Villa de Verano”, was initially listed at $88m, and sat on the market for only four months and 22 days. Besides a six-bed, 12,400 sq ft home that is complete with its own gym, theater, spa and aquarium, the 12-acre property also features a pool, a rose garden, an amphitheater, a guest property and a sporting area fitted with seven courts and a putting green. Its opulence stands out even among other palatial Hillsborough homes, which include Bing Crosby’s $25m home, Elon Musk’s $32m former home and the Levi Strauss-connected $17.8m Koshland Estate.

Yet Gilson says this sale is only a “stepping stone” into a market of homes catering to the incredibly wealthy.

“Even in the last year, there’s been a major increase of buyers from the AI world,” she said. “This could be just the beginning of the ultra luxury.”

Since the San Francisco-based companies OpenAI and Anthropic filed for initial public offerings earlier this summer, a new class of multimillionaires has entered the real estate race. An analysis by brokerage Compass described a “housing market increasingly segmented by income tier and proximity to AI-driven employment centers”.

Gilson said she has seen an influx of wealth among buyers coming not just from AI companies, but increasingly from other, traditional industries. She described a “definite increase” in those ultra-rich buyers taking off-market, “hidden” opportunities, meaning Gilson connects buyers to sellers without homes ever being listed.

In San Mateo county, where the sale took place, the median price of a single-family home increased by 8.5% between May 2025 and May 2026. San Francisco county saw a more than one-fifth increase, with median prices jumping from $1.8m to $2.2m.

content_html_zh:
旧金山湾区一座以科莫湖为灵感的豪华庄园以创纪录的 7000 万美元卖给了一位“人工智能世界”的买家，这是新技术财富热潮的最新迹象，该热潮正在将该地区的房价推向非凡的高度

金门苏富比国际房地产公司的房产经纪人詹妮弗·吉尔森表示，旧金山南部的这处房产不仅成为其富裕小镇希尔斯伯勒最昂贵的销售记录，比之前的纪录翻了一番，而且也是今年北加州最昂贵的销售记录。

吉尔森拒绝透露有关买家的任何细节，只透露 3000 Ralston Avenue 的新主人是人工智能行业的人士。 这是人工智能财富推动硅谷房地产繁荣的最新迹象。 上个月的一项分析发现，今年前六个月，旧金山有 140 多套房屋的售价至少比要价高出 100 万美元。

该房产名为“Villa de Verano”，最初挂牌价为 8800 万美元，上市时间仅 4 个月零 22 天。 除了一栋 12,400 平方英尺的六居室住宅（配有自己的健身房、剧院、水疗中心和水族馆）外，这座占地 12 英亩的房产还设有游泳池、玫瑰园、露天剧场、客用住宅以及配有七个球场和果岭的运动区。 它的富丽堂皇甚至在希尔斯伯勒的其他富丽堂皇的住宅中也脱颖而出，其中包括平·克罗斯比 (Bing Crosby) 价值 2500 万美元的住宅、埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 价值 3200 万美元的故居以及与李维·斯特劳斯 (Levi Strauss) 相关的价值 1780 万美元的科什兰庄园 (Koshland Estate)。

然而吉尔森表示，这次出售只是进入迎合超级富豪的住宅市场的“踏脚石”。

“即使在去年，来自人工智能领域的买家也大幅增加，”她说。 “这可能只是超奢华的开始。”

自从今年夏天早些时候，总部位于旧金山的 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 公司申请首次公开募股以来，一批新的千万富翁已经进入了房地产竞赛。 经纪公司 Compass 的一项分析描述了“住房市场日益因收入水平和与人工智能驱动的就业中心的距离而细分”。

吉尔森表示，她看到大量财富涌入的买家不仅来自人工智能公司，而且越来越多地来自其他传统行业。 她描述说，那些寻求场外“隐藏”机会的超级富有买家“明显增加”，这意味着吉尔森在房屋从未挂牌的情况下将买家与卖家联系起来。

在此次出售的圣马特奥县，2025 年 5 月至 2026 年 5 月期间，单户住宅的中位价格上涨了 8.5%。 旧金山县房价涨幅超过五分之一，中位价从 180 万美元跃升至 220 万美元。
